semiconductor_relevance: High — HMC Sales & Service specializes in reliability testing equipment for semiconductor packaging and electronic components.
summary: HMC Sales & Service is a distributor of semiconductor equipment focusing on reliability testing, including Highly Accelerated Stress Test (HAST) and Pressure Cooker Test (PCT) chambers. They provide a range of environmental stress testing solutions and additional equipment for quality assurance and failure analysis in the semiconductor industry.

regional_presence.Singapore: HMC Sales & Service has a strong presence in Singapore, serving as a key distributor for semiconductor manufacturing reliability equipment.
regional_presence.China: The company operates regional offices in China, enhancing its distribution capabilities in the region.
regional_presence.Philippines: HMC Sales & Service has established a presence in the Philippines to support its operations across Southeast Asia.
